eips.summary: Referenced as part of ongoing EL repricing work with audit reports expected on Monday's ACDT call.

moments.context: Ben noted that work continues on the EL around repricing EIPs 8037 and 8038, with updated blog post linked and audit reports to be discussed on Monday's ACDT call.
Terence speculated about Sepolia's future given decisions around 8037, and Barnabas suggested delaying the block hash check decision until after ACDT based on 8037/8038 outcomes.

eips.title: Quick Slots
eips.summary: Quick Slots was DFI'd from Hegota after its champion withdrew it to prioritize post-quantum work.

moments.context: Caspar said ETH Labs' PQ-first framing applies to the EIPs they push, like quick slots, and that they would accordingly withdraw it from Hegota.

Ben, asking whether Hegota's scoping should reopen, noted Caspar had already indicated a willingness to withdraw quick slots. In chat, champion Barnabé Monnot answered "Barnabe already offered to withdraw Quick Slots" with "let its withdrawal not be in vain".
Ben formally asked for objections to moving Quick Slots from CFI to DFI. Hearing none, he declared the decision made.

eips.title: Post-Quantum Material Registration
eips.summary: Post-Quantum Material Registration EIP was proposed for inclusion and accepted as PFI for Hegota.

moments.context: Ben introduced EIP-8483 for PQ material registration as a late proposal for Hegota inclusion and asked Justin Traglia to present it.
Justin Traglia described EIP-8483 as allowing validators and builders to register PQ keys ahead of a future fork, using two new execution request types and system contracts deployable soon.
Potuz commented there is no rush for the fork part but urgency in agreeing on the design, auditing the contract, and committing to a signature scheme for the community.
Ben concluded EIP-8483 is accepted as PFI, with CFI status to be proposed on a future call.
